newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU and Mexico finally agree on trade pact.
newsitem.headline: EU and Mexico finally agree on trade pact.

text.p: Mexico and the European Union have finally settled differences over a trade agreement and will initial a new treaty next week, the European Commission said on Thursday.

A statement from the Commission said following agreement between the EU member-states ambassadors on Thursday, an agreement covering economic partnership, political coordination and cooperation had been approved.

The EU and Mexico have long been at odds over the wording of a treaty to formalise relations. Mexico at first opposed a now-obligatory human rights clause and later objected to demands for changes on sea freight cargo trade.
